name: parallel-explore
description: /explore sends three subagents to investigate different parts of the codebase and merges their findings.

planAngles.title: Plan the angles
planAngles.description: Let a quick Haiku call split the question into three angles. Off: always implementation, usage & tests, config & docs.

mergeModel.title: Merge model
mergeModel.description: The model that merges the three reports: inherit (the session's), an alias such as sonnet or haiku, or a full model id.

timeoutMinutes.title: Explorer time limit (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: How long to wait for the explorers before merging what came back (1-60).
